question: Which one of the following scholars coined the term- Geography?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eratosthenes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term geography was first coined by Eratosthenes, a greek scholar (276-194 BC). 
 
• The work of Eratosthenes is similar to what is now known as geographical analysis, and he introduced some of the language that is still used today.
 
• The Pre-Cambrian Period is the longest era in the world's history of classification. 
 
• Eratosthenes is best known for being the first person to measure the Earth's diameter, which he did by using the detailed survey results that he was able to access in his library role; his calculation was remarkably precise.
 
• He was also the first, again with incredible precision, to measure the tilt of the Earth's axis.
 
• He developed the world's first global projection, integrating parallels and meridians based on his era's available geographic information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Herodotus** is the father of History.
 
• **Aristotle **was a greek philosopher and scientist.
 
 
• His work contribution are in Metaphysics, Politics, Rhetoric and science.
 
 
 
• **Plato **described 'justice' as having and doing what is one's own. In other words, everybody does their own work.
